title: Hilbert's 6th Problem: Axiomatization of Physics
exact_target: Give rigorous axioms for physical theories and justify the passage from microscopic particle mechanics to continuum descriptions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 61 (HIL-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
David Hilbert, Mathematical Problems (1900), Problem 6, English translation archived by D. E. Joyce.

status_qualification: The catalogue includes thermodynamics as a later framing. Hilbert supplies no fixed final axiom system or universally agreed completion criterion. Existing axiomatizations of particular theories constitute context rather than a settlement of this entire programme.
